t: The Controller is your main interface to the Energizer.$(br2)Right-click on the Controller to open its graphical user interface, and from there, you can turn the Energizer on or off, check how much energy is present in the machine, and see how it flows in and out of it.
控制器是你操作充能器的主要界面。$(br2)右键点击控制器即可打开它的图形界面，你可以在其中开启或关闭充能器、查看机器中存有多少能量，以及观察能量如何流入和流出。
If you hover over a control in the interface, a tooltip will be displayed with additional information or explanatory text for that control.$(br2)
如果你将鼠标悬停在界面中的某个控件上，就会显示一个提示框，提供该控件的额外信息或说明文字。$(br2)
$(l)Mandatory:$() at least one is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any vertical face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
$(l)必需：$()至少需要一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意竖直面（不能在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()是
